doc: Cross-scope leakage (Mem0 #5439, Graphiti #2065/#2066): two SAME-NAMED project directories (the classic collision), seeded with different facts through their own scopes. Scoped searches never return the other project's memories; the cross-scope search (across=1) returns results tagged with their scope; writes to one scope never appear in the other.

checks.name: scopeA search for a scopeB-only fact returns nothing

The work database is vacuumed on the aurora cluster nightly

evidence.evaluatedAs: no returned hit carries the scopeB-only marker (orbit relay / helios) — same-scope nearest-neighbor noise without the marker is not leakage
